stories.title: Des «propos délirants» : accusé d’écrits antisémites, Jordan Bardella poursuit Mediapart en diffamation

en.title: Described as 'delusional remarks': accused of antisemitic writings, Jordan Bardella sues Mediapart for defamation
en.summary: The National Rally president is pursuing legal action against Mediapart following publication of an article attributing antisemitic and conspiratorial statements to him from 2013. Bardella responded publicly on television, characterizing the allegations as part of a continuing pattern.

stories.title: Visite du pape en France : dans l’avion du retour, Léon XIV nuance les propos rapportés par les victimes sur le caractère « systémique » des violences sexuelles dans l’Eglise

en.title: Pope's visit to France: on return flight, Pope Leo XIV qualifies remarks reported by victims on "systemic" nature of sexual abuse in the Church
en.summary: The Pope clarified comments about sexual violence in the Church made during his French visit, characterizing it as abuses by certain organizations operating systematically rather than systemic violence throughout the institution.

stories.title: Le pape Léon XIV nuance le caractère systémique des violences sexuelles dans l'Eglise après sa visite en France

en.title: Pope Leo XIV qualifies systemic nature of sexual abuse in the Church following his visit to France
en.summary: The Pope clarified that he referred to certain Church organizations that sometimes committed abuses systematically, rather than describing systemic abuse throughout the institution.

stories.title: Après un hommage à l'Europe, le pape Léon XIV a achevé sa visite historique en France

en.title: After a tribute to Europe, Pope Leo XIV completed his historic visit to France
en.summary: Pope Leo XIV concluded a four-day visit to France with a speech in Metz emphasizing peace and interfaith dialogue, while calling on Europe to combat dishonesty in international relations before returning to Rome.

stories.title: Accusé d’avoir écrit des propos antisémites en 2013, Jordan Bardella dément « formellement »

en.title: Accused of writing antisemitic remarks in 2013, Jordan Bardella formally denies
en.summary: The National Rally president faces accusations that he wrote antisemitic comments when he was a young member of the Front National, which he categorically rejects.

stories.title: Soupçons d’antisémitisme : Jordan Bardella rattrapé par ses propos

en.title: Antisemitism suspicions: Jordan Bardella caught up by his remarks
en.summary: Reports allege the National Rally president wrote numerous antisemitic messages between 2013 and 2015, which he disputes, potentially undermining the far-right party's deradicalization strategy.

stories.title: "Antisémitisme obsessionnel" ou "barbouzerie" ? Six questions sur les propos attribués à Jordan Bardella par Mediapart

en.title: "Obsessive antisemitism" or "dirty tricks"? Six questions about remarks attributed to Jordan Bardella by Mediapart
en.summary: Mediapart reports that the National Rally leader made antisemitic remarks in conversations between 2013 and 2015. Bardella announced he will pursue legal action against the news outlet.

stories.title: "Des propos parfaitement délirants" : Jordan Bardella annonce porter plainte pour diffamation après les accusations d'antisémitisme portées par Mediapart

en.title: "Completely delusional remarks": Jordan Bardella announces defamation lawsuit after antisemitism accusations by Mediapart
en.summary: Mediapart's investigation accuses the National Rally leader of making antisemitic remarks in written conversations from 2013 when he was a young National Front activist. Bardella denies the allegations and plans to sue.

stories.title: Conservateur sur les questions éthiques, engagé dans la lutte contre les violences sexuelles : le voyage en équilibre du pape Léon XIV en France

en.title: Conservative on ethical issues, committed to combating sexual violence: Pope Leo XIV's balancing act during his visit to France
en.summary: The American pontiff concluded a four-day visit to France on September 28, marked by popular support and strong positions on secularism and end-of-life legislation. His trip demonstrated both traditional conservative stances on ethics and engagement with contemporary social issues.

stories.title: 🔴 En direct : le pape Léon XIV achève sa visite historique en France

en.title: 🔴 Live: Pope Leo XIV concludes his historic visit to France
en.summary: Pope Leo XIV is ending his historic visit to France.

stories.title: Propos antisémites attribués à Jordan Bardella, réquisistions contre Rachida Dati, journée de grève de mardi… L’actu de ce lundi 28 septembre

en.title: Antisemitic remarks attributed to Jordan Bardella, proceedings against Rachida Dati, Tuesday strike day… Monday September 28 news roundup
en.summary: Libération provides a summary of the main news stories from Monday, including Mediapart's report on antisemitic remarks attributed to Bardella and other developments.

stories.title: « Mediapart » rapporte des propos antisémites de Jordan Bardella, qui dénonce des « faux grossiers »

en.title: Mediapart reports antisemitic remarks by Jordan Bardella, who denounces "gross fakes"
en.summary: Mediapart reports that the National Rally leader repeatedly made antisemitic and conspiracy-related remarks in private conversations from 2013 at the start of his National Front career. Bardella characterizes the allegations as fabrications.

stories.title: Les gains de productivité ne suffiront pas à rentabiliser la facture exorbitante de l’IA

en.title: Productivity gains will not be enough to offset the exorbitant cost of AI
en.summary: A Bain & Company report projects AI-related expenses reaching six trillion dollars by 2031, with productivity gains and consumer applications insufficient to compensate. New markets must emerge to bridge the spending deficit.

stories.title: Satellites espions : le ministère des Armées va enfin lancer la nouvelle génération (IRIS)

en.title: Spy Satellites: the Ministry of Defence will finally launch the new generation (IRIS)
en.summary: France's Ministry of Defence will soon order two spy satellites as part of the IRIS program to replace the three currently operational CSO satellites.

stories.title: OPINION. « Russie : la guerre comme régime de redistribution » (Michel Santi)

en.title: OPINION. "Russia: war as a redistribution system" (Michel Santi)
en.summary: The Kremlin is increasing tax collection while protecting sectors essential to military operations, with some of the country's revenue now dependent on continuing the war.

stories.title: Plus de pétrole, plus de gaz, plus de profit : TotalEnergies assume ses objectifs de croissance dans les énergies fossiles

en.title: More oil, more gas, more profit: TotalEnergies commits to fossil fuel growth targets
en.summary: The French energy company plans continued investment in hydrocarbons through at least 2035 to meet global energy demand, drawing support from financial markets but criticism from climate advocates.

stories.title: Le Starship passe le cap de l’orbite

en.title: Starship reaches orbit milestone
en.summary: SpaceX's Starship achieved orbital flight for the first time on September 28, marking a historic milestone after three years of suborbital test flights.
